lessons.title: C++ translation units and build diagnostics
lessons.intro:
C++20; relevant standard headers and a main function are assumed. A C++ project compiles source files and links their definitions. Headers expose declarations, while implementation files provide definitions. Use the C++ compiler driver to link the standard C++ library. The commands here use GCC and C++20. Read compiler errors separately from linker errors, and distinguish both from runtime exceptions. A successful build is only the start of validation; assertions can check invariants during development.

Read each snippet, identify its effect, then complete a fragment. Examples are independent unless stated otherwise. Snippets may omit surrounding entry points and standard imports; displayed code is never executed by the tutor.

lessons.title: Initialization, auto, and const references
lessons.intro:
C++20; relevant standard headers and a main function are assumed. Prefer initializing an object at its declaration. Brace initialization rejects narrowing conversions such as a fractional double to int. auto deduces a value type and usually drops a reference; auto& preserves aliasing. const auto& gives a read-only view without copying. Read a declaration as a contract about conversion and ownership, rather than assuming that every assignment shares an object as in Python.

Prefer composing resource-owning standard types so compiler-generated special members manage cleanup: this is the rule of zero.

lessons.title: Threads, joining, and synchronization
lessons.intro:
C++20; relevant standard headers and a main function are assumed. C++20 jthread joins automatically when destroyed. A thread that borrows local storage must finish before that storage dies. mutex protects shared operations when every participant follows the same locking protocol; scoped_lock releases the lock on scope exit. atomic supports specified operations without data races, but does not make unrelated state safe. Unsynchronized conflicting access to ordinary memory is undefined behavior, not merely an unpredictable final number.
